text: Acme Pumps contract: 12% discount on seal kits. Payment terms net 30.
Acme Pumps support hours: weekdays 8am to 6pm. Your account manager is Dana Reyes.
Acme Pumps order 7781: 40 HP-200 shaft seal kits, shipped 3 November, tracking AP-7781.
Acme Pumps returns: unused parts can be returned within 60 days for a full refund.
Acme Pumps price list: HP-200 impeller 84 dollars, HP-200 seal kit 31 dollars.
Acme Pumps delivery address: warehouse 2, dock B. Deliveries before 2pm only.
Bayside Plumbing contract: 8% discount on seal kits and impellers. Payment terms net 14, priority shipping.
Bayside Plumbing support hours: 24/7 phone support for urgent pump failures. Your account manager is Sam Okafor.
Bayside Plumbing order 7790: 12 HP-400 impellers and 20 HP-400 shaft seal kits, shipped 5 November, tracking BP-7790.
Bayside Plumbing returns: unused parts can be returned within 30 days for store credit, not a refund.
Bayside Plumbing price list: HP-400 impeller 112 dollars, HP-400 seal kit 39 dollars, HP-200 seal kit 33 dollars.
Bayside Plumbing delivery address: front counter. Deliveries any time on weekdays.
XR-4471-B shaft seal kit for the HP-200 pump. Replace it when water drips from the housing near the shaft.
XR-4471-D shaft seal kit for the HP-400 pump. Replace it when water drips from the housing near the shaft.
XR-4417-B impeller for the HP-200 pump, brass. Replace it if the pump is noisy or the flow is weak.
XR-4417-D impeller for the HP-400 pump, stainless steel. Replace it if the pump is noisy or the flow is weak.
ZP-2201 priming kit. If the pump runs but moves no water, it has lost its prime. Fill the housing and restart.
WD-8800 standard warranty. It covers manufacturing faults. Keep your invoice.
